name: GapCode

knownPaths.description: GapCode home. Holds the CLI binary, chat history, skills, rules, packages, and config.toml. Persistent tool state, not disposable cache.

Update payloads staged by the GapGPT updater. Safe to delete: the updater re-fetches the current release the next time it runs. The same folder can hold a partially downloaded release that stalled, which is why it sometimes grows without ever finishing.
